paragraphs: Swift (TcpSwift) is a deterministic, multi-signal fusion TCP congestion control algorithm implemented directly in C++ for the ns-3.40 discrete-event network simulator. It targets long-distance and heterogeneous access paths — data-center fabrics, WiFi, LTE/5G, metro/long-haul WAN and satellite links — where fixed-parameter, single-signal algorithms struggle to balance throughput, delay and loss.
features: Multi-signal congestion awareness. ECN state, the congestion-avoidance
state machine, congestion-event semantics, RTT versus min-RTT and bytes-in-flight are consumed directly by the native congestion controller.
